original_question: Show that if n is prime and n > 2, then n is odd.
modified_question: Show that if n is prime and n > 2, then n is odd.
original_process: Step 1: Assume n is prime and n > 2.
Step 2: If n were even and > 2 it would be divisible by 2, contradicting primality; hence n is odd.
modified_process: Step 1: Assume n is prime and n > 2.
Step 2: We know n is odd because all primes > 2 are odd; hence n is odd.
reason: Modified step 2 cites 'all primes > 2 are odd' which IS the statement being proved; PRM must reject the circular appeal.
